messages:
Alex Chen: Morning — quick benefits/payroll Qs now that I'm live. A bunch of small ones: 1) I see HSA vs FSA choices on the benefits portal — since I started mid-year can I still enroll in HSA? 2) Do I need to submit a W-4 somewhere or was that handled during Greenhouse? 3) I paid to ship my monitor to my home (receipt attached) — what's the reimbursement flow? 4) Are company holidays or floating days prorated for people who start in Jan? TL;DR: where do I look and who should I ask for each? thanks :slightly_smiling_face:

Mica Patel: Welcome Alex :wave: — nice checklist. Short answers up front: HSA eligibility depends on your plan + prior coverage, W-4s are handled by payroll, expenses go through Expensify (Finance), and holidays/floats are prorated for partial first years. I'll DM links and mail templates. Ping @javier for payroll specifics.

Javier Cruz: Hi Alex — payroll here. Please upload any tax forms (W-4, state withholding) to the HR portal -> Documents -> Tax forms. If you filled something in Greenhouse, double-check it shows in the portal. State withholding rules vary by state; if you want extra withheld put it on the e-file or update line 6 for additional withholding. First paycheck will include prorated pay and deductions. If you want I can run a sample estimate — what state are you in?

Alex Chen: I'm in CA. I filled something in Greenhouse but not 100% sure it synced. Also attached receipt filename 'dell-shipping-0324.pdf' — do I upload to Expensify or send it to payroll?

Finance Bot: Automated notice: Expenses are processed via Expensify. Workflow: New Report -> attach receipt(s) -> select category 'Equipment Shipping' -> assign to approver (your manager) -> submit. Reimbursements post in the next two paycycles after approval. See https://intranet.redwood/expenses for step-by-step.

Mica Patel: For HSA: eligibility requires HDHP enrollment and no conflicting coverage. If you had prior coverage, please email proof to benefits@redwood.com. If you're not eligible for HSA, you can enroll in FSA (if offered) or the company HRA depending on plan. I'll send the plan docs and the new-hire enrollment window in a DM.

Samir Rao: Hey Alex — for the equipment shipping, if it's manager-approved just add me as the approver on the Expensify report or drop the receipt here and I'll OK it. On W-4: I can forward the onboarding packet you received or confirm the Greenhouse entry if you want.

Alex Chen: Thanks! I'll upload the W-4 to the portal and create the Expensify report now. Mica, please send plan docs. Javier, CA — appreciate the estimate offer. One more small thing: I got a health card in the mail but it's not active yet. Any activation steps?

Mica Patel: Healthcard activation typically completes within 24 hours after enrollment processes. If it hasn't activated after 24h, email benefits@redwood.com with last 4 of your SSN and the card ID and we'll escalate. Also note HSA pre-tax deductions begin the first payroll after enrollment is finalized (can take one pay cycle).

Javier Cruz: Got it. I ran a quick sample for a CA new hire on a prorated salary: your first net may look lower because it will include full-month deductions and prorated income; taxes are calculated on the gross amounts. If you want a tailored sample, DM me your salary start date and hourly/salary band and I can post a mock paystub.

Alex Chen: Appreciate it :thumbsup: I'll follow up after I upload. Final quick Q: are floating holidays available or do we only get the fixed list?

Mica Patel: We offer 2 floating holidays per year plus the standard company holidays. Floats prorate for partial years. Dropping the holiday calendar here: https://intranet.redwood/hr/holiday-calendar-2025

Mica Patel: (DM follow-ups) — I just sent you the benefits packet, the enrollment window, and the exact URL for uploading the W-4. If anything gets stuck ping me or @javier. Welcome again!
